event_venue_information:
About Club Passim

Club Passim is a legendary nonprofit listening room that has been a cornerstone of New England's music community since 1958. Originally known as Club 47 the venue has hosted icons like Joan Baez Bob Dylan Joni Mitchell and countless others who shaped American folk music.

The Venue Experience

Located in a cozy basement space in Harvard Square Club Passim offers an intimate setting where every seat provides excellent sightlines and acoustics. The venue presents over 400 shows per year ranging from traditional folk and bluegrass to singer-songwriter performances.

Music Programming

In addition to its regular concert series Passim hosts the annual Down Home Up Here bluegrass and old-time festival featuring workshops and jam sessions. The venue also runs open mic nights and maintains a School of Music offering workshops and classes for aspiring musicians of all ages.

title: Open Mic & Jam @ The Bebop
event_description: Weekly open mic and jam session hosted by Josh Riley. Musicians of all levels welcome to perform and collaborate in this vibrant Irish pub setting near Berklee College of Music.
sign_up: Sign up online or In Person
event_venue_information:
About The Bebop

The Bebop is a lively Irish pub and music venue situated at the intersection of Boylston and Mass Ave next to Berklee College of Music. From the owners of The Burren this venue has become a premier destination for musicians and music lovers in Boston.

Live Music Seven Nights a Week

The Bebop features live entertainment every night including bluegrass brunches on Sundays gypsy jazz on Saturdays Monday night jazz jams and Thursday open mic nights. The venue's proximity to Berklee means you'll often hear incredibly talented student musicians alongside seasoned professionals.

Atmosphere and Amenities

The venue offers a full menu of Irish favorites and American classics plus weekend brunch from 11am-3pm. With its welcoming atmosphere craft beer selection and consistent live music The Bebop has quickly become a favorite gathering spot for the Boston music community.

title: Open Mic Challenge @ Lizard Lounge
event_description: Long-running weekly open mic challenge hosted by Tom Bianchi featuring singer-songwriters and performers competing for prizes. Intimate basement venue with excellent sound.
event_venue_information:
About Lizard Lounge

Lizard Lounge is an intimate live music club located just north of Harvard Square beneath Cambridge Common restaurant. Since 1996 this subterranean venue with its signature red lighting and welcoming atmosphere has been recognized as one of Boston's best small music venues.

Diverse Musical Programming

The venue features live music seven nights a week ranging from rock and blues to jazz and folk. Session Americana and Club D'Elf are among the regular acts known for their jam sessions. The venue also hosts the legendary Lizard Lounge Poetry Jam on Sunday nights.

Venue Atmosphere

With its low ceilings plush Persian rugs quality sound system and 24 beers on tap Lizard Lounge creates an intimate connection between performers and audience. The venue's basement location and red lighting contribute to a unique ambiance that Rolling Stone called an intimate eclectic hot spot.

title: Open Mic @ Irish Village
event_description: Weekly open mic night for musicians poets and performers. House provides small drumset guitar keyboard and two mics. Local musicians gather to collaborate and share their talents.
event_venue_information:
About Irish Village

Irish Village has been a Brighton landmark since 1970 offering authentic Irish hospitality and perfect pints of Guinness. This neighborhood pub combines traditional Irish charm with a welcoming atmosphere for locals and visitors alike.

Music and Entertainment

The venue features live music every Friday and Saturday night along with weekly open mic nights trivia and karaoke. The back room has been recently renovated to accommodate various entertainment formats creating an ideal space for performers and audiences.

Pub Experience

Known for expertly poured Guinness and a great selection of beers on tap Irish Village also serves delicious toastie sandwiches. The warm wooden bar and friendly staff led by longtime manager Kieran create a genuine neighborhood pub atmosphere that has made this a Brighton institution for over 50 years.

title: Open Mic @ NEMPAC - Boston Public Market
event_description: Monthly open mic nights featuring diverse musical performances from the Boston community. All ages 18+ welcome to perform. Free community event in the heart of downtown Boston.
event_venue_information:
About Boston Public Market

Boston Public Market is a year-round indoor marketplace featuring local farmers fishermen and food producers. The market also serves as a community gathering space hosting cultural events and performances.

NEMPAC Partnership

The North End Music & Performing Arts Center brings live music to the market through their open mic series. These events showcase musicians from the Boston community including NEMPAC students and local artists performing everything from classical to contemporary styles.

Community Focus

The open mic nights at Boston Public Market create an accessible welcoming environment for performers and audiences. The events are free to attend and performers range from beginners to experienced musicians making it an ideal venue for artists at all stages of their musical journey.

title: Acoustic Open Mic @ Cantab Lounge
event_description: Long-running Monday night songwriter open mic hosted in this legendary Cambridge venue. Folk acoustic and singer-songwriter performances in an intimate setting with excellent sound.
event_venue_information:
About Cantab Lounge

Since 1938 Cantab Lounge has been the heart of live music in Cambridge's Central Square. This legendary dive bar presents live music seven nights a week in both the main lounge and underground performance space.

Musical Heritage

The Cantab has a rich history hosting blues jazz bluegrass and rock performances. For 27 years Tuesday Night Bluegrass was a Cambridge institution hosted by Geoff Bartley and featuring nationally-known artists. The venue continues to nurture emerging talent while honoring its storied past.

Dual Spaces

The venue features two performance areas - the upstairs lounge and the basement which hosts the renowned Boston Poetry Slam on Wednesday nights. With affordable drinks friendly staff and consistent quality programming Cantab Lounge remains a beloved neighborhood institution.
